items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: We started an orchestra together. We, Pop Foster, Willie Foster, and a couple of other guys, new guys.

ctx.x: Maybe you can tell me this. Nobody ever seems to know how it spells name. Was his first name Mac and his last name Murray?

Yeah, I couldn't say M-A-C. M-A-C. M-U-R-R-Y. Is it all one name? What was his first name? They called him Mac, see. Mac was maybe his first name. But his name altogether. I think it was Mac Murray, see. That was his name, Mac Murray. All together, see. Yeah. His first name. His first name. I don't just remember what, but they'd call him Mac, anyway. Mac. Mac. Okay. Yeah. He was, hey, pardon. Did you play with Henry Zeno once or twice? Yeah. I played with him. Pop Foster. And he had a brother, Willie Foster,…
Pop said there was something called the Rocell Band or something. Do you remember that name? Rocells? I don't know. I didn't get the name right.

items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Then we formed a little band around in New Orleans called the Rozeal's Band. And Roy Palmer- ... See Roy Palmer was first a guitar player where we had a little three piece band, see.

ctx.x: No. We learned string bass, any string bass player, any kind of string bass can play a little bit guitar. And any good guitar player can play string bass. items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: He had left working for McCall's and he started working with a little band, a guy called Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer, yes. Roy Palmer was our guitar player.

ctx.x: It was around 1997 and 1999 when my brother bought that big bass for me. Uh-huh. He had left working for McCall's and he started working with a little band, a guy called Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer, yes. Roy Palmer was our guitar player. You had to see what became a trombone player? No, let me see what Roy was playing. Roy was playing trumpet. Uh-huh. And Joe Johnson was our guitar player. So Joe Johnson learned trumpet and Roy Palmer and Roy Palmer was good too. Joe died. That's what I tell the guys, they read about…
Sure. Why would you play? Bass drum?
